tagline: Paste a CSV, map columns onto a chart — the dataset lives in the GIF.
description:
The table you paste stays on this device, inside the app. Close it, come back, the last dataset and the last mapping are still there. Nothing is uploaded.

Load a CSV or paste comma-separated text. Pick an alluvial, a treemap, a bump, a beeswarm — the unusual charts RAWGraphs is for, not just bars. Point columns at Steps, Size, Hierarchy. Copy SVG takes the picture with you.

Want a friend looking at the same chart? Press Play together, then Invite in the bar above, and send the link. When anyone remaps a field, everyone sees the new picture.

An unofficial port of RAWGraphs by DensityDesign Lab, Calibro and INMAGIK. This copy keeps the load → map → draw loop and a working set of visual models, fully offline. Excel workbooks are not read — save as CSV first.
